integrity: The proof is a direct density factorization in minimum-range-normalized coordinates. The mean normalized variance is computed from endpoint-plus-iid-interior moments, and the covariance family follows from beta range moments. Exact-rational replay checks the algebra but is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The parent law must be continuous uniform on a finite interval.
The exact independence is for S^2/R^2 and the sample endpoints, not for S^2 and R.
Older spacing or invariant-statistic literature may contain an equivalent normalized-shape factorization.
title: Uniform-sample variance separates exactly into range and normalized shape
